component: text tower (EmbeddingGemma2TextModel + mean pooling + L2 normalize)
largest_tested_evidence: tests/pcc/test_text_model.py::test_text_model[b1_s32768] vs HF fp32, rerun on the E5a code (commit c62d1e8c1f): passed, last_hidden_pcc 0.997830, embedding_cosine 0.999638 (bars 0.99; log tt-ops/runs/embeddinggemma-2/e5a/logs/review_s32768.log)
hf_validated_note: 65536 has no HF reference; it is validated only by padding equivalence vs 32768 (see largest_run_evidence)
largest_run_evidence: E5a tt-ops/runs/embeddinggemma-2/e5a/scripts/long_ctx.py (logs/long_ctx.log): a 32768-token prompt in bucket 32768 vs the same prompt padded into bucket 65536, embedding cosine 1.000000 (max abs diff 3.0e-8); a 65536-token forward is finite, unit-norm and bit-identical on repeat, 2.23 s eager; host peak RSS 22.8 GB. No HF reference at 65536 (fp32 CPU reference needs about 4x the 24 GB measured at 32768)
decode: not applicable: encoder, no KV cache or decode step

reduction_reason_e5a.summary: E5a keeps dense additive masks (TT native sliding_window_size was 1.5-2.5x slower and cannot mask key padding) but stores them in bfloat4_b (0.5625 B/element) and skips out-of-band SDPA blocks with a block map at buckets >= 4096. Largest feasible bucket 65536; HF-validated max still 32768.

device_bytes.masks_live_per_forward: 3 (band constant, sliding, full): 7.2 GB at 65536, 29 GB at 131072 of 32 GB device DRAM (131072 infeasible)

reduction_reason_e5a.host_bytes: band constant built on the host in bf16: 8.6 GB at 65536, 34 GB at 131072
reduction_reason_e5a.path_to_close_gap: a mask-free padding scheme (per-row valid length in SDPA) or block-sparse masks; an HF reference that streams attention (or stored goldens) for > 32768

reduction_reason.summary: (E1, superseded by reduction_reason_e5a) The functional attention bakes the |q-k|<=512 band and key padding into dense additive [B,1,S,S] bf16 masks (TT SDPA cannot combine sliding_window_size with attn_mask). Mask memory grows as S^2.

device_bytes.masks_live_per_forward: 3 (band constant, full mask, sliding mask) => 6 GiB at 32768, 24 GiB at 65536 of 32 GiB device DRAM, before intermediates (repeat/add outputs) and activations

reduction_reason.reference_bytes: HF fp32 CPU reference at 32768 peaked at 24.0 GB RSS (/usr/bin/time -v, Maximum resident set size 23982524 kB); 65536 would need about 4x, above the 61 GB host RAM, so no reference could validate it
reduction_reason.sdpa_note: models/demos/gemma4/tt/attention/operations.py documents a 32768-token Q limit for the non-chunked SDPA path
reduction_reason.path_to_close_gap: E5 optimize: native sliding_window_size for no-padding batches, attn_mask_block_map / bfp4 masks, or chunked Q with per-chunk masks; a CPU reference that streams attention (or stored goldens) for > 32768

vision.component: vision tower (Gemma4VisionModel) + embed_vision (RMSNorm no scale + Linear 768->512)
vision.input_contract: processor output: pixel_values [B, N, 768] pre-patchified, position_ids [B, N, 2] (x, y; -1 = padding)
vision.largest_tested_evidence: tests/pcc/vision/test_vision_model.py::test_soft_tokens (5 images at N=2520, 8 video frames at N=1260; soft-token PCC 0.9977-0.9997 vs HF fp32 at E2, 0.9972-0.9997 on the E5b path)
vision.reduction: none: the processor fixes the patch count, and both buckets run at their maximum
vision.untested: videos longer than 8 frames (32-frame video = batch 32 x 1280, not probed); non-default max_soft_tokens (70/140 for images); windowed SDPA for batches 2-7 at bucket 1280 (they use the masked path)
vision.decode: not applicable: one-pass bidirectional encoder per image / frame

optimized_e5b.summary: E5b keeps every capability (buckets, patch counts, batch). Policy: bf16 weights, HiFi2 + fp32 acc matmuls and SDPA, per-shape SDPA chunk/grid table, bfp4 key-padding mask, windowed SDPA (no mask) for batch >= 8 at bucket 1280, fused axial RoPE, activations in L1 for one image.
optimized_e5b.new_device_input: VisionDeviceInputs.windows: cu_window_seqlens [2B+1] uint32 ROW_MAJOR (valid-patch prefix per row), a persistent trace input like the others
optimized_e5b.windowed_attention_precondition: valid patches are a prefix of each row (processor output always is); prepare_inputs raises otherwise for batch >= 8 at bucket 1280
optimized_e5b.mask_bytes: bfp4 [B,1,S,S]: 0.5625 B/element, 3.7 MB per image at 2560 (bf16 was 13.1 MB)
optimized_e5b.l1_activations: one image (2560 patches): [*,768] activations and the residual stream in L1 (64 KB per bank rule), plus the QKV output (91 KB per bank) and MLP up / gate outputs (121 KB per bank each); batch > 1 stays in DRAM (128 KB per bank for every tensor clashes with op circular buffers)

audio.component: audio tower (Gemma4AudioModel: conv subsampling + 12 conformer layers + output_proj) + embed_audio (RMSNorm no scale + Linear 1536->512)
audio.input_contract: feature-extractor output: input_features [B, T, 128] log-mel (100 frames/s), input_features_mask [B, T] (True = valid, right padded)
audio.hf_max_evidence: recon: 60 s of audio -> 750 tokens (feature extractor caps at 2999 frames); here 30.00 s -> 2999 frames -> 750 tokens
audio.attention: causal-local band 0 <= q - kv < 12 (HF chunk 12, context_left 13), evaluated on 32-query blocks x 64 keys
audio.largest_tested_evidence: tests/pcc/audio/test_audio_model.py::test_soft_tokens[s30] (30 s real speech, 750 tokens; soft-token PCC 0.99905 vs HF fp32) and test_audio_layer.py::test_conformer_stack[s30]
audio.reduction: none: the feature extractor bounds a clip at 750 tokens and the largest bucket (768) runs it
audio.decode: not applicable: one-pass causal-local encoder per clip; no streaming cache

full_model.component: EmbeddingGemma2Model (vision + audio towers, on-device soft-token merge, text encoder) + ST mean pooling + L2 normalize (+ MRL 512/256/128)
full_model.shared_context: every modality draws from one token sequence: text tokens + per image (2 markers + up to 280 soft tokens) + per video frame (2 + up to 140) + per audio clip (2 + 25 per second)

max_text_tokens_per_item.why: model card context window (8,192 tokens, shared by all modalities). The wrapper accepts max_seq_len up to 65536 (E5a bucket limit, see reduction_reason_e5a; HF-validated to 32768); full-model inputs were tested up to 2080 tokens (bucket 4096)
max_text_tokens_per_item.evidence: tests/pcc/test_full_model.py::test_full_model_item[text_long] (2080 tokens, b1_s4096, cosine 0.99997 vs HF fp32)

images_per_item.why: 8192 tokens / (280 soft tokens + 2 markers) at the default 280-token image budget; the vision tower runs all images of a batch as one [n, 2560-patch] forward (key-padding mask [n,1,2560,2560] bf16 = 13 MB per image), far below device DRAM at 29
images_per_item.evidence: test_full_model_item[mixed_two_images] (2 images + text, 537 tokens) and test_batched_mixed_modalities (b2_s512_image2x2560)

audio_seconds.why: the HF feature extractor caps a clip at 2999 mel frames = 750 soft tokens (E3); several clips per item share the 8192-token context (about 320 s of audio in total by tokens)

video_frames.why: processor_config.json video_processor max_frames 32 at 1 fps; 32 x (140 + 2) = 4544 tokens fits the 8192 context. All frames of a batch run as one [F, 1280-patch] vision forward
video_frames.evidence: test_full_model_item[video_text] (8 frames x 120 soft tokens, 986 tokens, b1_s1024_video8x1280)

batch.tested: text 8 (perf b8_s512), 3 (mixed batch), image+text 2, single audio / video items
batch.note: batch size is not padded; each (batch, buckets) is its own ShapeKey / trace

full_model.reduction: none against the model card: 8192 tokens, 280-token images, 32 video frames and 30 s clips are all inside the supported buckets; the larger multi-image / 32-frame / multi-clip combinations are untested
